name: Lisboa
mandate: PrompTugal.news Lisboa: AI and technology in Lisboa, the capital whose centre of gravity is its universities and research institutes, the Unicorn Factory startup hub and the national AI projects, and what reaches Lisboa from Portugal, Europe and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Lisboa is where Portugal's AI money and institutions meet. The University of Lisbon is spending over 20 million euros on two AI data centres, INESC-ID has won 27.2 million euros for a sustainable AI centre, and the national language model AMALIA was presented at Técnico's innovation centre. The city's own startup hub, Unicorn Factory Lisboa, runs an AI community with Microsoft, and funded startups such as Augusta Labs and DOJO AI are based here. The city council's own use of AI is thinly documented in what we could read, so research, startups and national projects, not city hall, are Lisboa's centre of gravity.

ai_news.title: Government funds press archives to be made available to the Portuguese AI model AMALIA
ai_news.summary: On 19 November the Council of Ministers approved a programme in which Visapress, the collective-rights body for press publishers, pays news outlets to digitise archives (9 million euros, possibly up to 15 million) and to let the AMALIA model and state-run research use them (6 million euros). The article does not mention Lisbon.
ai_news.ai_path: National funding to supply training and research data to AMALIA, the open Portuguese language model presented in Lisbon (see the AMALIA entry): one step from AI, and the Lisbon link is only through AMALIA, not stated on the page.

ai_news.title: Web Summit opens in Lisbon with humanoid robots as speakers and a focus on physical AI
ai_news.summary: AICEP reports that the tenth Web Summit opened in Lisbon on 9 November with a stronger focus on physical AI. Humanoid robots from Chinese companies take part as official speakers, including a wheeled two-armed robot by Galbot made for shifts in shops, pharmacies and factories. Delegations from China's Ministry of Commerce and Cyberspace Administration attend, and about 300 Brazilian start-ups take part. The programme covers AI agents, AI-supported research, digital regulation and new working models.
ai_news.ai_path: An event held in Lisbon whose stated focus this year is physical AI and AI agents: directly about AI. Read from the public agency's page, not from the summit's own site.

ai_news.title: Lisbon drone maker Beyond Vision raises over 28 million euros to speed up AI and swarm technology
ai_news.summary: Beyond Vision, a Lisbon company making unmanned aerial systems, secured more than 28 million euros co-led by Índico Capital Partners and Lince Capital. Part of the money is meant to scale production and to accelerate its AI and swarm technology.
ai_news.ai_path: A Lisbon hardware company that says it will use new funding to build AI and swarm software: one step from AI.

ai_news.title: University of Lisbon builds two AI data centres
ai_news.summary: ULisboa will invest over 20 million euros in two data centres for AI, high-performance computing and secure research data, at Técnico's Taguspark campus in Oeiras and at the Faculty of Sciences in Lisbon. Companies and startups will also be able to use them, with completion expected by 2028.
ai_news.ai_path: Computing built for AI workloads at a Lisbon university, one of the two sites inside the city: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Portugal's responsible AI consortium reports its results
ai_news.summary: The Center for Responsible AI, a publicly funded consortium now led by Sword Health after Unbabel's collapse, reports about 49 million euros of public and 27 million of private investment and expects 150 million euros of turnover by the end of 2026. Partners include Priberam and NeuralShift. We cannot tell from the article which partners work in Lisboa.
ai_news.ai_path: A national AI product consortium: directly about AI. The Lisbon link is not stated on the page.

ai_news.title: AMALIA, an open Portuguese language model, is presented in Lisbon
ai_news.summary: The open-source model for European Portuguese, built by a consortium of five universities including Técnico, is aimed at public services and businesses. It was presented at the Técnico Innovation Center in Lisbon.
ai_news.ai_path: A national large language model, presented in Lisbon: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Lisbon applied AI lab Augusta Labs closes its first round at 50 million euros
ai_news.summary: The lab builds custom AI for companies, private equity firms and government agencies. Its angels include founders from Sword Health, OutSystems and Feedzai. The round size was not disclosed.
ai_news.ai_path: A Lisbon company that sells applied AI work: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: INESC-ID wins 27.2 million euros for a sustainable AI centre in Lisbon
ai_news.summary: The research unit, associated with Técnico, leads a centre of excellence on sustainable and trustworthy AI, with 13 million euros from Horizon Europe's Teaming for Excellence and 14.2 million of national money. The Max Planck Institute for Software Systems and the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence are partners.
ai_news.ai_path: A Lisbon research centre dedicated to AI: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: DOJO AI raises 6 million dollars for agent-run marketing
ai_news.summary: The company, headquartered in London and Lisbon, closed a seed round at a 30 million dollar valuation, led by Armilar with Heartfelt VC. Its software uses autonomous agents to analyse marketing data and act on it.
ai_news.ai_path: A company with a Lisbon base selling AI agents: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Public administration tests AI in pilots with Lisbon university researchers
ai_news.summary: At the AI Summit AP, a Ciências ULisboa professor from the LASIGE centre described the national administration institute's AI XLab programme, where each pilot pairs a public body with a university and an industry partner. The Faculty of Sciences of the University of Lisbon is in three ongoing pilots, which could become regular public services.
ai_news.ai_path: Public services piloting AI with a Lisbon faculty: directly about AI. The programme is national, the Lisbon link is the faculty.

ai_news.title: Champalimaud Foundation and Técnico open a neurorobotics lab with an embodied AI line
ai_news.summary: The two institutions signed a five-year partnership on 18 February to create a lab inside the foundation's Neurotechnology Warehouse in Lisbon. One of its four research areas is embodied AI, on how artificial systems build models of the world by acting in it. The foundation says the lab positions Lisbon as a reference hub for natural and artificial intelligence.
ai_news.ai_path: A new Lisbon lab that includes AI research as a core line: directly about AI.

gaps: The city council's own sites (lisboa.pt, lisboaaberta.cm-lisboa.pt) still answer 403 to us on 17 November (the page body is a short block page of about 5,000 characters, so there is no content to fetch at an offset). The LxDataLab entry therefore still rests on search snippets, and the council's business desk, news and procurement notices are not reachable. base.gov.pt answers 301 and we did not find a council notice there; Lusa wire copy is not checked.

We found no named council business desk or contact for Lisboa. Unicorn Factory Lisboa and Startup Portugal's Lisbon office are the routes we could read. The Unicorn Factory contact page shows a general address that is spelled differently on two of its own pages (the home page footer and a variant with a different spelling on the contacts page), so we link the pages and do not copy an address.

Feeds on 17 November: ECO (works, 22 items, nothing Lisbon-AI since 16 November), NOVA FCT (works but carries only jury notices, not news), Champalimaud (works but holds one stale homepage item from 2018), Startup Portugal (valid but empty), HR Portugal (now answers 403 to us). None found for the council, Unicorn Factory, AICEP or Dealroom. AICEP's news list page is readable as HTML and is the better route.
Lisbon AI Week dates: a press article says 19 to 23 October and the organisers' own page says 21 to 27 September 2026 (and now announces 2027 as coming). We use the organisers' page.

We cannot read the Web Summit pages by rule, so the summit's own AI programme is not covered here; the AICEP report of 16 November is the public-agency view. Unicorn Factory's events page is a Luma embed, which we do not open, so the dates of Unblock AI #09 and Lisbon Tech Evening stay missing (the home page lists them without dates).

The AIhub member list shows names and one-line descriptions but not each firm's headquarters, so the members are listed as AIhub community members, not as Lisboa-based. Sword Health, Priberam, Feedzai, Unbabel and Farfetch are still not placed in Lisboa by a page we opened.

Investors are still thin. Armilar's base city is not stated on a page we opened, and Portugal Ventures, Lince Capital and Índico gave us no page of their own (the Unicorn Factory home page links lince-capital.com, not opened). The Banco de Fomento's new fund of funds is still unconfirmed.

Missing: Lisbon hospitals' AI use, the ISCTE, NOVA SBE and Católica AI centres, and the Unicorn Factory startup list as data (the startups page is about 1.2 MB of markup and was not parsed). The Soft Landing Program terms are not published at any address we reached (see its entry). Discord's new Lisbon engineering hub (AICEP, 12 November) is not AI news by our test and is left out.
Talent is not filled, by decision pending from Dinis on naming individuals.

Fourth pass, 19 November: ECO feed (works) and AICEP news list checked. Only one item added (Visapress and AMALIA). Left out: Kodly (AICEP, 19 November) is described as founded in Porto, not Lisbon; Priberam and Kenya APB webinar (AICEP, 19 November) does not place Priberam in Lisbon and is online. Nothing Lisbon-specific found dated 17 to 18 November. The council sites were not retried.

voice.lede: Lisboa, pá: seven hills, one very busy tram, and more AI conferences per square kilometre than there are pastéis de nata in Belém.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Lisboa, a capital que nunca dorme: AI and tech in Lisboa, with the universities and the Unicorn Factory as the big brains, plus whatever news sails in from Portugal, Europe and the world. Independente, and every fact comes with a receipt.
voice.gravity: Lisboa is where the universities build data centres, the institutes win millions, and a national language model gets its stage at Técnico. The startups come to Alvalade, the angels come with their cheque books, and the Câmara, bless it, keeps its AI plans to itself for now. Research and startups, sim senhor, not city hall.
voice.gaps_intro: Ainda não sabemos tudo, pá. Here is what Lisboa has not told us yet:

start_company.name: Unicorn Factory Lisboa: Incubation Program
start_company.what: Founder-driven programme from pre-seed to seed, with no equity taken, fully online and no registered company needed. It cites over 1,000 startups supported since 2012 and over 200 mentors. The next batch closes in early December 2026 (its pages say 1 and 3 December).

start_company.name: Unicorn Factory Lisboa: Active Programs and thematic hubs
start_company.what: Open calls for mobility and cleantech, a global scaling cohort and agritech and foodtech acceleration, plus membership programmes with partners for AI (Google, Microsoft and the Center for Responsible AI), cleantech, healthtech and industrials.

start_company.name: AIhub membership and coworking
start_company.what: AI community with tiers from free (Discovery) to paid (Immersion and Catalyst), coworking from a 15 euro day pass and private offices. Prices as published, plus VAT.

start_company.name: Unicorn Factory Lisboa: Soft Landing Program
start_company.what: Listed on the hub's menu as support for founders setting up in Lisbon. On 17 November the menu entry links to an application form on a Microsoft forms address, not to a page of terms, and the guessed address /soft-landing/ returns 404, so we still cannot state its terms.

start_company.name: Startup Portugal One Stop Shop (Lisbon office at Cais Português, Pavilhão de Portugal)
start_company.what: Centralised information and personalised support, online and in person, for those who want to found, operate and scale a business from Portugal, with offices in Lisboa and Porto.

start_company.name: Startup Portugal: programmes and incubator network (RNi)
start_company.what: National agency for the startup ecosystem. Runs the monthly Above & Beyond Hangouts, the Tech Foundry Portugal deep tech programme and Road 2 Web Summit, and keeps the national incubator network RNi.

start_company.name: Empresa na Hora (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado, via gov.pt)
start_company.what: Counter service to create quota companies, single-member quota companies and public limited companies quickly. The gov.pt page was updated on 4 September 2026 and names the registry institute as responsible.

investors.what: Co-led the funding round of a Lisbon drone maker that plans to speed up AI and swarm technology.
